tonight.title: The Odyssey
tonight.why: Tonight, lose yourself in the monumental epic of "The Odyssey." It's not just a journey home; it's a brutal, god-defying test of cunning and endurance that promises a spectacle for the ages.

releases.title: Avengers: Doomsday
releases.take: Three universes, one apocalypse – finally, a superhero crossover that truly earns its 'doomsday' title with maximum collateral damage.

releases.title: The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping
releases.take: Panem's prequel just dropped, proving that even a dystopian past has its own grim charms and deadly games.

releases.title: Other Mommy
releases.take: This isn't your average 'mother knows best' tale, unless 'best' involves existential dread and a remarkably unsettling doppelgänger.

critic.title: The Odyssey
critic.blurb: For those craving a truly unsettling experience, "Other Mommy" delivers a masterclass in psychological dread. It cleverly twists the familiar into something deeply sinister, leaving you questioning what's real long after the credits roll.
